test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A can do a piece of work in 15 days and B does the same work in 25 days. In how many days will A and B together complete this work?
solution:
**Given:**

A completes work in 15 days

B completes work in 25 days

**Concept:**

Total work done = 1/(1/A's time + 1/B's time)

**Calculation:**

Total work done = 1/(1/15 + 1/25)

⇒ ​​​​9{{3} over 8} days

**Therefore, A and B together will complete the work in 9{{3} over 8} days.**
